description.narrative:
Insatsens övergripande mål är ett samhälle där alla medborgare har möjlighet och kan agera för att utkräva ansvar. IA:s vision är en rättvis värld med starka medborgare där integritet och ansvarsutkrävande är centralt för samhällens utveckling. (A just and equitable world, where citizens are empowered and integrity is central to vibrant societies.)
IA antog en ny strategi 2018 och nuvarande strategiperiod löpte ursprungligen fram till 2023. IA hade tänkt att då övergå till en rullande strategiprocess fr o m 2022, då tanken var att årligen formulera treåriga strategiplaner som alltså naturligen kan revideras vid nästa strategiuppdatering. På detta sätt var tanken att IA skulle kunna verka mer agilt och vara snabbare i sin respons på frågor och utmaningar som uppstår. Med anledning av den starka påverkan Covid 19-pandemin visat sig ha på det civila samhället har IA beslutat sig för att snabba på övergången till rullande strategi och börja direkt. Därför kommer IA redan från 2020 att övergå till treåriga strategiplaner som revideras varje år. På så sätt får IA en strategiprocess årligen med en treårig horisont. Sida behöver formellt årligen godkänna varje ny strategi eftersom en rullande strategi per definition blir ny men det är en ganska enkel övning. Frågan är indikerad som en dialogfråga.
Strategin syftar till att uppnå tre strategiska mål: achieve, convince och amplify.
Achieve:
IA ska uppnå resultat som är hållbara och inkluderande och till gagn för medborgare. IA vill genom applikationen DevelopmentCheck skapa en återkopplingscykel som stärker hållbarhet och medborgarnas möjlighet att ta del av och påverka beslut i samhället. Man betonar särskilt vikten av att nå de mest marginaliserade. Enligt IA:s resultatramverk siktar det här målet framförallt mot att förändra människors beteenden, både rättighetsbärare och ansvarstagare. IA siktar på att påverka så att ansvarstagare och rättighetsbärare gemensamt bidrar till att åtgärda minst 50 % av de problem som rapporteras (s k fix rate).
Amplify:
IA siktar mot att bygga partnerskap för att öka, pröva och utvärdera sina aktiviteter. Genom att samarbeta med andra organisationer kan IA:s metod användas, spridas och utvecklas. Genom att testa innovationer i pilotprojekt får man idéer som sedan skalas upp, ibland med hjälp av större partner, och genererar erfarenheter i större skala som därefter systematiskt utvärderas. Detta innebär också att IA måste vara i teknologisk framkant och ha en rimlig lösning för mobilteknologi i sina verksamhetsområden.
IA avser att söka samarbeten med starkare nationella organisationer för att kunna nå skalbarhet i sina projekt. Tanken är att genom att dra lärdomar från lokal nivå kan IA se att det finns lösningar som ligger bortanför den lokala kontexten, t ex utbetalningar av lärarlöner. Genom att föra dialog om den iakttagelsen med beslutsfattare på regional eller nationell nivå hoppas IA nåbredare och även kunna påverka fler än de rättighetsbärare som är omedelbart berörda av IA:s projekt. Ett samarbete med starkare aktörer kan också vara nödvändigt när det gäller att granska tekniskt mer komplicerade projekt, så som t ex infrastruktursatsningar.
Convince:
IA:s ambition är att bevisa värdet av öppna och allmänna återkopplingsmekanismer för att inspirera andra aktörer till liknande lösningar. För att kunna göra detta kommer IA samla in evidens för fördelarna genom applikationen DevelopmentCheck, framförallt med avseende på ekonomi, miljö och sociala faktorer. Appen ska vara en naturlig rapporteringskanal för både medborgare och beslutsfattare. Man vill bygga koalitioner med andra aktörer och övertyga sådana som i sin tur har stor påverkan på andra.
Uppdaterad strategi 2021
IA uppdaterade sin strategi under 2021 och formulerar sig nu så här:
By 2023 Integrity Action will be at the forefront of demonstrating the transformational value of citizen-centred accountability to sustainable development.
Achieve
Achieve results for citizens that maximise quality, durability and inclusivity.
We will:
- Work with partners to develop evidence driven, contextualised pathways for sustained and inclusive citizen-centred accountability - Enable even the most marginalised citizens to act as monitors and benefit from monitoring - Incentivise institutions to fix at least 50% of problems identified by citizens.
Amplify
Collaborate to amplify results, fuel further innovation and embed citizen-centred accountability.
We will:
- Work with partners to sustain and scale up CCA approaches testing them as we go and evidencing results, - Take learning and insights from collaborations, feed into future R&D, and share widely to stimulate improved CCA practice globally - Be agile with tech developments to ensure the efficiency, accessibility and local adoption of tools.
Convince
Build a robust case for citizen-centred accountability to inspire its mainstreaming
- Lead on evidencing the economic, environmental and social case for citizen-centred accountability - Build or support coalitions to call for the mainstreaming of citizen-centred accountability at the global level and within countries - Convince influencers and institutions to demand citizen-centred accountability.

Integrity Action har ansökt om stöd från Sida om 28 MSEK för att genomföra sin globala strategi "Ambition for open citizen feedback" under perioden 1 oktober 2020 - 30 september 2024
Insatsen syftar till att bidra till samhällen där alla medborgare har möjlighet och också utkräver ansvar av de ansvarstagare medborgarna förlitar sig på. Detta görs genom att arbeta med tre målområden: 1) uppnå, 2) förstärka, och 3) övertyga. Integrity Action vill uppnå direkta resultat för medborgarna i form av förbättrad samhällsservice (uppnå). Genom att sprida sin metod hoppas Integrity Action kunna få andra organisationer att anta en liknande ansats till gagn för ännu fler människor (amplify). Integrity Action avser att hela tiden samla in kunskap om hur metoden fungerar för att kunna stärka argumentet och bidra till att andra aktörer använder samma metod (övertyga).
Insatsens totala budget för programperioden är 105 MSEK.

Integrity Action has applied to Sida for funding of 28 MSEK to carry out its global strategy "Ambition for open citizen feedback" during the period 1 October 2020 - 30 September 2024.
The intervention aims at helping build “societies in which all citizens can – and do – successfully demand integrity from the institutions they rely on”. To realise this goal, Integrity Action has identified three objectives or focus areas: 1) achieve, 2) amplify, and 3) convince. Integrity Action intends to reach direct positive results for citizens (achieve). By working with other organisations, Integrity Action hopes to spread its methodology and make other actors adopt a similar approach which would benefit even more rights-holders (amplify). Integrity Action plans to build evidence that proves the impact of its approach and use this knowledge to generate further amplifying partnerships (convince).
The interventions total budget for the program period is 105 MSEK.

title.narrative: Amendment to the Agreement Integrity Action 2022

description.narrative:
Examples of achieved results or performed activities mentioned in Integrity Action's (IA) narrative report for the period July 2023-June 2024:
* Approx. 100 monitors: Approximatelly 100 monitors were involved in projects during the year and some of them received trainings from IA during the year (see the 29 monitors in South Africa below). (IA's Head of Operation mentioned that they aimed for somewhere a couple of hundred, but this did not materialize.) However, some of the monitors had not been able to actually work in projects after (for instance the 29 in South Africa) due to reasons such as delays in implementation of operations among IA's partners. In for instance South Africa and as part of the COMPACT programme, IA is only one of many organisations involved in the EU project delivery, and there are too many municipalities and the different methods for follow-up were spread to thin.
* The management of the de-merger: Sucessful management of the de-merger from Crown Agents. Integrity Action ceased being an independent subsidiary of the Crown Agents group on 26 July 2024. They said in the reporting that their partners, funders, peers, and stakeholders could rest assured that IA was unaffected by Crown Agents Limited entering liquidation on the 1 August 2024.
IA's own reflection: "Whilst what has happened within the Crown Agents group is very disappointing, we believe that our initial decision to merge was at that time the most appropriate one. We have seen the potential opportunities that joint action with a larger organization may provide for a small charity like ours. As such we remain keen to explore future options for beneficial mergers and innovative ways of working to deliver impact through an increase in scale of delivery, capacity and capability."
* A new tool developed - Green Accountability: Carbon Integrity Monitor- - IA stated: "One of our greatest achievements this year was Integrity Actions selection to join the first Green Accountability Technology Accelerator cohort. This six-month programme, launched in May 2024 by Climate Collective and funded by the World Banks Global Partnership for Social Accountability (GPSA), placed Integrity Action among 4 pioneering entrepreneurial teams. They were selected to develop tech-enabled tools that enhance citizen oversight and decision making in climate finance and climate action. The accelerator programme will support Integrity Actions development of Carbon Integrity Monitors. This is a tool designed specifically for citizen-led monitoring of carbon projects to support transparency, equity, and accountability in the voluntary carbon market."
* Ran a survey and co-designed a programme - Ukraine Civil Society Strengthening: Integrity Action is a member of RISE Ukraine a coalition of 50 Ukrainian and international organizations working for Ukraine's Reconstruction Integrity, Sustainability and Efficiency. Integrity Action led a co-design process to develop a programme to Strengthen Ukrainian Civil Society, in partnership with Patients of Ukraine. This included running a CSO survey to ensure that the views of Ukrainian CSOs were front and centre to the design process.
* Established 10 Integrity Clubs in Kenya: IA renewed their partnership with their longstanding partner Kesho Kenya to build on the learning of the SHINE programme and established new Integrity Clubs in 10 secondary schools located in underserved areas of Kilifi County in Kenya, specifically in Magarini Sub- County.
* Two studies published - Achievements in IA's Learning Segment: Two studies were published that examined the impact of the IA citizen-monitoring approach, and whether it improves infrastructure quality or saves public money. IA hosted events to share the findings more widely, including at the 2023 Open Governance Partnership (OGP) Global Summit in Tallinn, Estonia. The first of these studies was from Kwale County, Kenya. Volunteer researchers assessed the condition of 283 public infrastructure projects. This included over 100 early child development and education centres, alongside health dispensaries, water kiosks, maternity wings, and more. The study compared projects whose construction had been monitored by community members (such as through Integrity Actions VOICE programme) with those that had not been. The finding was that the monitored projects were statistically much more likely to be in good shape. The second study was from Ghana and resulted from more than two years of research by INTRAC and the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science & Technology (KNUST). This research provided insight into three ways in which community monitoring adds value: a) Early detection of problems b) Enhanced transparency, which incentivises contractors to follow proper processes and c) Increased community ownership.
* Gender and Social Justice: IA reported on their internal Action Plan for gender and social justice from their policy Power with: Delivering on our gender & social justice commitment. (see page 17 in the Annual Narrative Report). Sida noted that initially there were 12 areas in the Action Plan, but 9 areas remained after IA was no longer a part of Crown Agents and therefore IA only reported in these 9 areas. Out of the 9 areas, IA had marked 5 as completed, 1 as partially completed and 3 as no actions were taken. The latter was primarily due to lack of time and resources. One example of an area addressed was "no 1. Assess all initiatives against the IA's Gender, Climate, Social Justice and Responsiveness Scale". IA said that they together with partners assessed the actual two active projects they had in the year. They both scored 'sensitive' which was the second highest grade on a scale of 1-4 meaning Blind, Unjust, Sensitiv, Transformative.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
